title: Polish bank transfer details dialog with order summary, improved copy UX, and WhatsApp confirmation CTA

requirements.summary: Pass the clicked plan context into the bank transfer details dialog and render it as a clear Order Summary block at the top.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user clicks “Pay via Bank Transfer” on a specific plan card, the bank transfer dialog shows an order summary that matches the clicked plan (network, plan title, data, and displayed price).
The dialog continues to display the configured bank details fields as before.
No changes are made to any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.

file_operations.description: Track the currently selected plan summary (network, plan title, data amount, displayed price) when the user clicks “Pay via Bank Transfer”, and pass it into the BankTransferDetailsDialog as a new prop. Ensure this is wired from the specific plan card that was clicked. Use existing shadcn-ui Button composition already present; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend BankTransferDetailsDialog to accept an optional order summary prop and render a compact "Order Summary" block at the top of the dialog content (above bank details). Keep all existing bank details fields and the unavailable-state behavior intact. Use existing shadcn-ui Dialog/Alert/Button building blocks (compose only; do not modify ui components); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Reduce friction in the bank transfer dialog by adding a “Copy all details” action and clear numbered instructions in English, while retaining per-field copy capability.
acceptanceCriteria: A “Copy all details” button is available when bank details are present and copies a well-formatted multi-line block to the clipboard.
The dialog includes a concise numbered instruction list (e.g., transfer exact amount, keep proof, contact support for confirmation).
Existing per-field copy buttons continue to work (or are replaced only if the new experience is clearly better and still provides copy capability for all fields).

file_operations.description: Add a single prominent "Copy all details" action when bankDetails is present. Implement formatting as a multi-line block that includes bank name, account name, account number, and conditionally IBAN/BIC when available. Keep existing per-field copy buttons working. Add a concise numbered instruction list in English for completing the transfer and confirming payment. Use existing shadcn-ui Button/Alert components via composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a WhatsApp confirmation CTA inside the bank transfer dialog that opens WhatsApp to the existing number with a prefilled message containing the selected plan summary and a proof prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: The bank transfer dialog includes a button/link that opens a WhatsApp chat to 09033449260 with a prefilled message that includes the plan’s network, plan name, data, and price.
The WhatsApp CTA is only shown when bank details are available and a plan has been selected via the “Pay via Bank Transfer” action.
The existing “Order via WhatsApp” flow on plan cards remains unchanged and continues to work.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated helper to build a WhatsApp URL for bank-transfer payment confirmation that reuses the existing WHATSAPP_NUMBER and URL formatting logic, and supports a prefilled message containing the selected plan summary plus a prompt to attach/describe transfer proof. Keep getWhatsAppOrderUrl behavior unchanged.

Add a prominent WhatsApp confirmation CTA inside the dialog that uses the new WhatsApp helper to open chat to 09033449260 with a prefilled confirmation message. Only render this CTA when both bankDetails is present and an order summary was provided (i.e., user came from “Pay via Bank Transfer” on a plan card). Use existing shadcn-ui Button (asChild link pattern where appropriate) via composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the dialog receives the selected plan summary only when opened from the “Pay via Bank Transfer” action, so the WhatsApp confirmation CTA gating condition is met without affecting the existing “Order via WhatsApp” link on plan cards. Use existing shadcn-ui Button composition already present; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
